# assignmentB2SadilaJayasinghe

`assignmentB2SadilaJayasinghe` contains one function, `count_all_missing_by_group()`, which counts the number of missing values in every column of a data frame, separately for each level of a grouping column. It is a quick way to see where data is missing before starting an analysis.

## Installation

You can install the package from GitHub with:

```r
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2SadilaJayasinghe", ref = "0.1.0")
```

## Example

Count the missing values in each column of the `airquality` data set, for each month:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2SadilaJayasinghe)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```

By default the output is ungrouped. Use `.groups = "keep"` to keep it grouped by month:

```{r}
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month, .groups = "keep")
```
